name: Wasurenagusa
source:
After graduating from college, our hero finds himself unable to secure full-time employment and scrapes by with part-time work. One day, Sora receives an unexpected invitation from his high school alumni association.
He was born and raised in a small mountain village, a place whose population has been steadily dwindling. His former school has already closed, and the village itself has been absorbed into a neighboring town. According to the letter, the area is slated to be completely cleared and rebuilt. The old school, too, will soon be demolished.
Before that happens, a final class reunion is to be held in the school building.
The invitation bears no signature and lists no return address. Sora has no idea who sent it, and the letter’s vague wording leaves him uneasy. Still, drawn by nostalgia and the chance to see his old friends once more, he decides to return—to revisit the village.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20020819204444fw_/http://gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/2001/wa/wasurenagusa/index.htm]gamelexgs[/url]]
translation:
大学毕业后，男主找不到全职工作，只能靠打零工度日。某天，空收到高中校友会出人意料的邀请。

他出生并成长在一个人口不断减少的小山村。母校已经关闭，村子也被并入邻镇。信中说，这片地区将被彻底清理并重建，旧学校也将在不久后拆除。

在那之前，学校大楼将举行最后一次同学会。

邀请函没有署名，也没有回信地址。空不知道是谁寄来的，含糊的措辞让他感到不安。然而，怀旧之情以及再次见到老朋友的机会吸引着他，他决定回去，重访那座村庄。
